title: Agentic solve performance
description: TRT agentic-solve outcomes and Claude cost from jira_agent and claude_session_metrics. Merge status is filled by agentic-solve-pr-status. Time to merge starts when the jira-solver step starts.

list.name: upstream_repo
list.label: Repo
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT upstream_repo FROM `openshift-ci-data-analysis.ci_data_autodl.jira_agent` WHERE PartitionTime >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 90 DAY) AND agent IN ('trt-jira-solver', 'trt-review-responder') AND IFNULL(upstream_repo, '') != '' ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Solves started
panels.description: Initial jira-solver runs in the selected time range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM `openshift-ci-data-analysis.ci_data_autodl.jira_agent` WHERE agent = 'trt-jira-solver' AND PartitionTime >= TIMESTAMP_MILLIS(${__from}) AND PartitionTime < TIMESTAMP_MILLIS(${__to}) AND upstream_repo IN (${upstream_repo:singlequote})

SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM `openshift-ci-data-analysis.ci_data_autodl.jira_agent` WHERE agent = 'trt-jira-solver' AND PartitionTime >= TIMESTAMP_MILLIS(${__from}) AND PartitionTime < TIMESTAMP_MILLIS(${__to}) AND upstream_repo IN (${upstream_repo:singlequote}) AND pr_url IS NOT NULL AND pr_url != ''

SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM `openshift-ci-data-analysis.ci_data_autodl.jira_agent` WHERE agent = 'trt-jira-solver' AND PartitionTime >= TIMESTAMP_MILLIS(${__from}) AND PartitionTime < TIMESTAMP_MILLIS(${__to}) AND upstream_repo IN (${upstream_repo:singlequote}) AND pr_status = 'merged'

SELECT IFNULL(SAFE_DIVIDE(
  COUNTIF(pr_status = 'merged'),
  COUNTIF(pr_url IS NOT NULL AND pr_url != '')
), 0) AS value
FROM `openshift-ci-data-analysis.ci_data_autodl.jira_agent` WHERE agent = 'trt-jira-solver' AND PartitionTime >= TIMESTAMP_MILLIS(${__from}) AND PartitionTime < TIMESTAMP_MILLIS(${__to}) AND upstream_repo IN (${upstream_repo:singlequote})

panels.title: Median hours to merge
panels.description: Hours from jira-solver step start to GitHub merge.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT q[OFFSET(50)] AS value
FROM (
  SELECT APPROX_QUANTILES(hours, 100) AS q
  FROM (
    SELECT TIMESTAMP_DIFF(merged_at, started_at, MINUTE) / 60.0 AS hours
    FROM `openshift-ci-data-analysis.ci_data_autodl.jira_agent`
    WHERE agent = 'trt-jira-solver' AND PartitionTime >= TIMESTAMP_MILLIS(${__from}) AND PartitionTime < TIMESTAMP_MILLIS(${__to}) AND upstream_repo IN (${upstream_repo:singlequote})
    AND pr_status = 'merged'
    AND started_at IS NOT NULL
    AND merged_at IS NOT NULL
  )
)
WHERE q IS NOT NULL

SELECT q[OFFSET(90)] AS value
FROM (
  SELECT APPROX_QUANTILES(hours, 100) AS q
  FROM (
    SELECT TIMESTAMP_DIFF(merged_at, started_at, MINUTE) / 60.0 AS hours
    FROM `openshift-ci-data-analysis.ci_data_autodl.jira_agent`
    WHERE agent = 'trt-jira-solver' AND PartitionTime >= TIMESTAMP_MILLIS(${__from}) AND PartitionTime < TIMESTAMP_MILLIS(${__to}) AND upstream_repo IN (${upstream_repo:singlequote})
    AND pr_status = 'merged'
    AND started_at IS NOT NULL
    AND merged_at IS NOT NULL
  )
)
WHERE q IS NOT NULL

panels.title: Total cost
panels.description: Claude cost for solve and review-responder runs in the time range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT IFNULL(SUM(m.total_cost_usd), 0) AS value
FROM `openshift-ci-data-analysis.ci_data_autodl.jira_agent` j
LEFT JOIN `openshift-ci-data-analysis.ci_data_autodl.claude_session_metrics` m
  ON j.JobRunName = m.JobRunName
 AND m.PartitionTime >= TIMESTAMP_MILLIS(${__from})
 AND m.PartitionTime < TIMESTAMP_MILLIS(${__to})
 AND (
      (j.agent = 'trt-jira-solver' AND STRPOS(m.Source, 'solve') > 0)
      OR (j.agent = 'trt-review-responder' AND STRPOS(m.Source, 'review') > 0)
 )
WHERE j.agent IN ('trt-jira-solver', 'trt-review-responder')
  AND j.PartitionTime >= TIMESTAMP_MILLIS(${__from}) AND j.PartitionTime < TIMESTAMP_MILLIS(${__to}) AND j.upstream_repo IN (${upstream_repo:singlequote})

panels.title: Median cost per merged PR
panels.description: Median of solve plus review-responder cost for issues whose PR merged. Includes follow-up jobs in the time range.

targets.rawSql:
WITH costs AS (
  SELECT j.issue_key, SUM(m.total_cost_usd) AS cost
  FROM `openshift-ci-data-analysis.ci_data_autodl.jira_agent` j
  LEFT JOIN `openshift-ci-data-analysis.ci_data_autodl.claude_session_metrics` m
  ON j.JobRunName = m.JobRunName
 AND m.PartitionTime >= TIMESTAMP_MILLIS(${__from})
 AND m.PartitionTime < TIMESTAMP_MILLIS(${__to})
 AND (
      (j.agent = 'trt-jira-solver' AND STRPOS(m.Source, 'solve') > 0)
      OR (j.agent = 'trt-review-responder' AND STRPOS(m.Source, 'review') > 0)
 )
  WHERE j.agent IN ('trt-jira-solver', 'trt-review-responder')
    AND j.PartitionTime >= TIMESTAMP_MILLIS(${__from}) AND j.PartitionTime < TIMESTAMP_MILLIS(${__to}) AND j.upstream_repo IN (${upstream_repo:singlequote})
  GROUP BY j.issue_key
),
merged AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT issue_key
  FROM `openshift-ci-data-analysis.ci_data_autodl.jira_agent`
  WHERE agent = 'trt-jira-solver' AND PartitionTime >= TIMESTAMP_MILLIS(${__from}) AND PartitionTime < TIMESTAMP_MILLIS(${__to}) AND upstream_repo IN (${upstream_repo:singlequote}) AND pr_status = 'merged'
)
SELECT q[OFFSET(50)] AS value
FROM (
  SELECT APPROX_QUANTILES(c.cost, 100) AS q
  FROM costs c
  JOIN merged USING (issue_key)
)
WHERE q IS NOT NULL

SELECT IFNULL(SUM(m.total_cost_usd), 0) AS value
FROM `openshift-ci-data-analysis.ci_data_autodl.jira_agent` j
LEFT JOIN `openshift-ci-data-analysis.ci_data_autodl.claude_session_metrics` m
  ON j.JobRunName = m.JobRunName
 AND m.PartitionTime >= TIMESTAMP_MILLIS(${__from})
 AND m.PartitionTime < TIMESTAMP_MILLIS(${__to})
 AND (
      (j.agent = 'trt-jira-solver' AND STRPOS(m.Source, 'solve') > 0)
      OR (j.agent = 'trt-review-responder' AND STRPOS(m.Source, 'review') > 0)
 )
WHERE j.agent = 'trt-jira-solver' AND j.PartitionTime >= TIMESTAMP_MILLIS(${__from}) AND j.PartitionTime < TIMESTAMP_MILLIS(${__to}) AND j.upstream_repo IN (${upstream_repo:singlequote})

panels.title: Review cost
panels.description: review-responder cost from the initial job and later follow-up jobs.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT IFNULL(SUM(m.total_cost_usd), 0) AS value
FROM `openshift-ci-data-analysis.ci_data_autodl.jira_agent` j
LEFT JOIN `openshift-ci-data-analysis.ci_data_autodl.claude_session_metrics` m
  ON j.JobRunName = m.JobRunName
 AND m.PartitionTime >= TIMESTAMP_MILLIS(${__from})
 AND m.PartitionTime < TIMESTAMP_MILLIS(${__to})
 AND (
      (j.agent = 'trt-jira-solver' AND STRPOS(m.Source, 'solve') > 0)
      OR (j.agent = 'trt-review-responder' AND STRPOS(m.Source, 'review') > 0)
 )
WHERE j.agent = 'trt-review-responder' AND j.PartitionTime >= TIMESTAMP_MILLIS(${__from}) AND j.PartitionTime < TIMESTAMP_MILLIS(${__to}) AND j.upstream_repo IN (${upstream_repo:singlequote})

SELECT
  TIMESTAMP_TRUNC(j.PartitionTime, DAY) AS time,
  SUM(IF(j.agent = 'trt-jira-solver', m.total_cost_usd, NULL)) AS `trt-jira-solver`,
  SUM(IF(j.agent = 'trt-review-responder', m.total_cost_usd, NULL)) AS `trt-review-responder`
FROM `openshift-ci-data-analysis.ci_data_autodl.jira_agent` j
LEFT JOIN `openshift-ci-data-analysis.ci_data_autodl.claude_session_metrics` m
  ON j.JobRunName = m.JobRunName
 AND m.PartitionTime >= TIMESTAMP_MILLIS(${__from})
 AND m.PartitionTime < TIMESTAMP_MILLIS(${__to})
 AND (
      (j.agent = 'trt-jira-solver' AND STRPOS(m.Source, 'solve') > 0)
      OR (j.agent = 'trt-review-responder' AND STRPOS(m.Source, 'review') > 0)
 )
WHERE j.agent IN ('trt-jira-solver', 'trt-review-responder')
  AND j.PartitionTime >= TIMESTAMP_MILLIS(${__from}) AND j.PartitionTime < TIMESTAMP_MILLIS(${__to}) AND j.upstream_repo IN (${upstream_repo:singlequote})
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Daily merges
panels.description: PRs merged per day. PartitionTime is the solve row, so a merge is counted when that solve is inside the time range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT TIMESTAMP_TRUNC(merged_at, DAY) AS time, COUNT(*) AS merges
FROM `openshift-ci-data-analysis.ci_data_autodl.jira_agent`
WHERE agent = 'trt-jira-solver' AND PartitionTime >= TIMESTAMP_MILLIS(${__from}) AND PartitionTime < TIMESTAMP_MILLIS(${__to}) AND upstream_repo IN (${upstream_repo:singlequote})
  AND pr_status = 'merged'
  AND merged_at IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Solves
panels.description: One row per issue. Cost and duration include the initial solve and every review-responder run in the time range.

targets.rawSql:
WITH phase AS (
  SELECT
    j.issue_key,
    j.upstream_repo,
    j.agent,
    j.pr_url,
    j.result,
    j.pr_status,
    j.started_at,
    j.merged_at,
    j.num_review_rounds,
    m.total_cost_usd,
    m.duration_ms
  FROM `openshift-ci-data-analysis.ci_data_autodl.jira_agent` j
  LEFT JOIN `openshift-ci-data-analysis.ci_data_autodl.claude_session_metrics` m
  ON j.JobRunName = m.JobRunName
 AND m.PartitionTime >= TIMESTAMP_MILLIS(${__from})
 AND m.PartitionTime < TIMESTAMP_MILLIS(${__to})
 AND (
      (j.agent = 'trt-jira-solver' AND STRPOS(m.Source, 'solve') > 0)
      OR (j.agent = 'trt-review-responder' AND STRPOS(m.Source, 'review') > 0)
 )
  WHERE j.agent IN ('trt-jira-solver', 'trt-review-responder')
    AND j.PartitionTime >= TIMESTAMP_MILLIS(${__from}) AND j.PartitionTime < TIMESTAMP_MILLIS(${__to}) AND j.upstream_repo IN (${upstream_repo:singlequote})
)
SELECT
  s.issue_key,
  s.upstream_repo,
  s.pr_url,
  s.result AS solve_result,
  s.pr_status,
  s.started_at,
  s.merged_at,
  IF(s.pr_status = 'merged' AND s.started_at IS NOT NULL AND s.merged_at IS NOT NULL,
     TIMESTAMP_DIFF(s.merged_at, s.started_at, MINUTE) / 60.0, NULL) AS hours_to_merge,
  IFNULL(r.review_rounds, 0) AS review_rounds,
  IFNULL(s.cost, 0) + IFNULL(r.cost, 0) AS cost_usd,
  (IFNULL(s.duration_ms, 0) + IFNULL(r.duration_ms, 0)) / 1000.0 AS duration_s
FROM (
  SELECT
    issue_key,
    ANY_VALUE(upstream_repo) AS upstream_repo,
    ANY_VALUE(pr_url) AS pr_url,
    ANY_VALUE(result) AS result,
    ANY_VALUE(pr_status) AS pr_status,
    ANY_VALUE(started_at) AS started_at,
    ANY_VALUE(merged_at) AS merged_at,
    SUM(total_cost_usd) AS cost,
    SUM(duration_ms) AS duration_ms
  FROM phase
  WHERE agent = 'trt-jira-solver'
  GROUP BY issue_key
) s
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    issue_key,
    SUM(num_review_rounds) AS review_rounds,
    SUM(total_cost_usd) AS cost,
    SUM(duration_ms) AS duration_ms
  FROM phase
  WHERE agent = 'trt-review-responder'
  GROUP BY issue_key
) r USING (issue_key)
ORDER BY s.started_at DESC
